$comment: P9-05 (Phase 9/10 hardening): the machine-readable form of docs/baseline.md's 'Stable Baseline' section. This file is what .github/workflows/ci.yml's upstream-watch job diffs the live nanocoai/nanoclaw release tag against — a mismatch does not mean this project is broken, only that a newer upstream release exists and docs/version-compatibility.md's upstream-compatibility review process should be (re-)run before promoting this pin. Update this file by hand, in the same commit as any docs/baseline.md pin change and any resulting ADR — never let CI or a script rewrite it automatically (LAW-09: the pin is a deliberate, reviewed promotion, not something that should silently track upstream churn).
